description: Propose (preview) or save a new version of a program's Architecture tab model (`PUT /programs/{programId}/architecture`), such as an architecture derived from a technical design document. Call FIRST without `confirmed` (or with `dryRun: true`) to validate and normalise `body`, compute the `diff` against the current version, and check `conflicts` with mapped initiatives without writing anything. Then call with `confirmed: true` and `ifVersion` set to the `currentVersion` you read (0 when none exists) to save version N+1 with `source: "mcp"`. If the save removes or retires an element that initiatives build on, pass those element ids in `acknowledgeConflicts`. Only the program lead, program owner, or a company Owner may save (`architecture_edit_requires_program_lead`). Saving never approves a version or changes the approval policy: a program that requires architecture approval still holds scoping until a person approves the version in the Console.

acknowledgeConflicts.description: Element ids whose removal or retirement conflicts with mapped initiatives you acknowledge after reviewing the preview.

body.description: Complete structured ProgramArchitectureBody for the Architecture tab. Every element across all sections must have a unique lowercase slug `id` (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`) and a non-empty `name`. All cross-references (`capabilityIds`, `fromId`, `toId`, `owningCapabilityId`, `valueStreamIds`, `stakeholderIds`, `mastersInformationIds`, `informationIds`, `elementIds`) must resolve to elements present in the target section of this same body. `capabilities` and `applications` are required sections and cannot be added to `naSections`.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifVersion.description: The `currentVersion` read from `anyforge_get_program_architecture` (0 when no architecture is saved yet). Required when saving (`confirmed: true`); a stale value is refused with `architecture_modified`.
